meta.title: Historical savings update correctly on bids when an RFQ is converted into an auction
gaps: Verify that the Historical Savings value is updated based on the auction final price rather than the original RFQ price.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the Historical Savings value is updated based on the auction final price rather than the original RFQ price.

Confirm the Overview rendered without errors or broken values.
